resources.string: Showing real system state. Tap a mode to switch.
Allow access to read and change battery modes.
Shizuku isn\'t running, so only Doze exemptions are visible. Start Shizuku to see Restricted apps and switch modes.

⚡ Unrestricted - exempt from Doze and app standby. Instant push, background sync and downloads keep running. Costs more idle battery.

⏱️ Optimise (default) - Android balances battery and freshness. Cached apps are frozen; notifications may wait for Doze maintenance windows.

🚫 Restricted - no background work. Jobs run rarely, background notifications may not arrive. Best for bloatware and rarely used apps.

Realme UI / ColorOS: the Athena process manager kills apps swiped from Recents, even Unrestricted ones. To keep an app alive, open Recents, tap the app card's menu and choose Lock (padlock).

Unrestricted is about running while the phone is on. It does not make an app start after a reboot - that is Autostart Manager's job.
